user.title: Proscenic Air Fryer
user.description: Add a stock Proscenic/Tuya air fryer. Enter your Proscenic account details and fryer IP address. The password is used once to fetch the Local Key and is not stored.

advanced_options.name: Advanced Options
advanced_options.description: Usually leave these unchanged. Device ID and Local Key are fetched automatically when left blank.
